note: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase / PSNProfiles). Every guide below is written in this guide's own words from the cited sources. A guide marked checked_in_game false carries a note saying it has not yet been checked in the game by this guide's author.

sources.Exophase: trophy list as reported via Push Square (no direct link kept)
sources.PSNProfiles: trophy list and tracked counts as reported (no direct link kept)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are done — there is no extra task hiding behind it. PowerPyx and GTABase both put the whole run at about 200 hours, nearly all of it on the 100% checklist for A Long Road, and both confirm no online play, no DLC and no second playthrough is needed. Keep cheats off for the whole run: both guides say cheats switch trophies and saving off.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: it pops when you finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1. Just play the first mission through; PowerPyx and GTABase both list it as the first story trophy and confirm it cannot be missed. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Pops when Chapter 1 ends — PowerPyx says it unlocks as the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins, and GTABase agrees. Unmissable; keep playing the story. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2's closing trophy. PowerPyx and GTABase both place it at the start of Chapter 3, after the Welcome to Vice City mission. Story-only, cannot be missed. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3's closing trophy. PowerPyx says it arrives after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life; GTABase agrees. Unmissable. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4's closing trophy, awarded after the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero, per PowerPyx. GTABase confirms it cannot be missed. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold for finishing the story's final mission — PowerPyx ties it to the same final mission as the Chapter 4 closer, Starting From Zero, and GTABase says free roam carries on afterwards, so the whole cleanup can wait until after the credits. Unmissable. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. PowerPyx notes this mission is also the moment character switching between Jason and Lucia opens up, which is what makes the partner trophies possible later. Unmissable. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3, per PowerPyx and GTABase. Just play the mission; it cannot be missed. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Child's Play, a Chapter 4 mission, per PowerPyx and GTABase. Unmissable. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Headliners in Chapter 4, per PowerPyx and GTABase. Unmissable. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4, per PowerPyx and GTABase. Unmissable. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for Operation Savage Glory, the Chapter 5 mission, per PowerPyx and GTABase. Unmissable — it is the last story trophy before the endgame cleanup begins. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, per PowerPyx and GTABase: the 100% checklist, found after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable. The requirements are lenient — PowerPyx puts it near 60% true completion: all robberies, bank vaults, gang operations, underwater discoveries, shooting-range golds, drone races and Bret's Target Decks in full, plus 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges and 300 stunts. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts, in any mix: PowerPyx and GTABase break them down as 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, and both say flying under bridges is the quickest way to build the total. The optional challenge on each stunt is not needed — performing it once counts. Track it under Progress > Activities > Stunts; the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — PowerPyx and GTABase list them as fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (sink one basket), playing an arcade game, winning a race, and performing a stunt. Check what is left under Progress > Activities. Most of them happen naturally while working on the other trophies, so PowerPyx advises not to chase this one early. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across 12 ranges, per PowerPyx and GTABase. PowerPyx's range guide lists all 12 locations. The ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger, so GTABase suggests doing them before attempting that trophy. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — one win per location is enough for the trophy, per PowerPyx and GTABase, but the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so GTABase advises finishing each location while you are there. PowerPyx lists all 14 locations in its drone-race guide. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; GTABase counts 40 unique race locations, and winning the same race twice does not add to the total. PowerPyx links the same 40-race list. Races also count toward the race type in Master of None, so these overlap nicely.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. PowerPyx says Cal is met in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, and after that he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple map icon; GTABase agrees. Follow his fishing questline through to the challenge and win it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game. PowerPyx names the four in-game video games — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home, and Bang For Your Buck on arcade cabinets around Leonida — and says you only need to reach the end of one, not beat every challenge in it. GTABase confirms the same four.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only questline for Andy, starting in Chapter 3 when he calls and texts his Belville address, per PowerPyx and GTABase. Five quests in order — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the last one awards the trophy. All of it stays available after the story. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's treasure-diving line, marked automatically in Chapter 1 after the Island Dreams mission, per PowerPyx; GTABase says he wants 7 shipwrecks cleared, with purple chest markers and a metal detector to dig treasure from the ocean floor. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 but texts Jason again in Chapter 2–3, so the line is not missable — PowerPyx even notes calling Brian as Jason can speed the callback up. Track it under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, per PowerPyx and GTABase: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes, with the last one awarding the trophy. All stay available after the story. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. PowerPyx and GTABase agree only certain lines count — Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries) are confirmed, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count. GTABase notes the remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed, so watch the trophy's own progress counter. None of them are needed for 100%, and all stay open after the story. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List: 16 sports cars to steal and deliver to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon), unlocked in Chapter 3 when the Key Cloner arrives in Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, per PowerPyx and GTABase. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check them against the list; GTABase says hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best hunting ground, and cars delivered in better condition pay more. Still doable after the story. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only line for Tyrone, starting after Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, per PowerPyx and GTABase: destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City (the Take Out Kitty Litter jobs), and once enough are gone Tyrone hands over the final job, Spin On This, which awards the trophy. Available after the story. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: UNCONFIRMED missable — the only trophy any guide flags. PowerPyx and GTABase both warn about a Chapter 1 meditation that vanishes after Chapter 1, and neither has confirmed whether the trophy needs it.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations, per PowerPyx and Push Square, tracked under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. Meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia together counts twice, and the last spots need both characters, unlocked after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. UNCONFIRMED MISSABLE — the only trophy any guide flags: PowerPyx and GTABase both warn about a Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house, where Lucia walks to the balcony in the morning after Down to Earth; follow her, accept, and meditate. It raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot, and nobody has confirmed whether the trophy needs it — do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting line: after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, Jason gets a text marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County (Lucia cannot receive it), per PowerPyx and GTABase. Hunt the animals Bret requests on his Target Decks and bring them back as Jason; his first quest hands over the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle. PowerPyx and GTABase both say it is still unconfirmed which animal exactly triggers the trophy, and the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets — you do not need all of them. PowerPyx links all 18 set locations, and GTABase says the Progress menu's Collections section shows how close each set is. Pick the three sets whose cards you keep tripping over and finish those.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at any 100 locations: hold Up then R1 to scan with the phone's WAiNK app. PowerPyx and GTABase break the pool down as 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags — far more than 100, so scan whatever you pass. The 100% checklist wants 100 WAiNK scans too, so this lands on the way.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 Challenges. PowerPyx and GTABase both say the 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way there, and there are 10 more challenges than needed, letting you skip the hardest ones. Track them under Progress > Challenges; many complete themselves while you chase the other trophies.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Needs both characters together, so earliest after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 — call your partner with Right on the D-pad then Triangle, per PowerPyx and GTABase. Cause enough trouble to reach 4 stars, then get out of the red heat zone (not just the flashing search area). PowerPyx's easiest route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and helicopters struggle to follow; GTABase agrees. It also tends to pop on its own during bank vault robberies, which always bring 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back while staying wanted (flashing red and blue) the whole time. PowerPyx and GTABase both recommend the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 — rob a couple of items in each, break the safe with sticky bombs, and keep moving. The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after the third shop; if nothing appears, hit a fourth. Body armor, sticky bombs and healing items help.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) — you do not need to drive them, per PowerPyx and GTABase. Stand by a busy road and scan passing traffic; the game counts 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist wants 200 base models scanned, so this arrives early. Check totals under Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming). PowerPyx says it slows time, highlights weak spots and drains the purple Focus bar, lasting only a few seconds — so fill Focus first (eat, drink, wash up at home; Adrenaline stretches it) and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556. Gang-operation thugs work; PowerPyx and GTABase both note it does not seem to count police, soldiers or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a big passenger jet docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge at VCIA — planes parked out on the airfield do not count, per PowerPyx and GTABase. PowerPyx says the easiest is the jet at gates E3/E4: drive through the airfield fence, use the stairs and door by the boarding bridge, board, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly about 1 km from the airport and the trophy pops (slightly delayed). Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — PowerPyx and GTABase both place the tanks at the south end of the base; drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot enemies until it pops. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3, which unlocks the Snap Gun and marks jewelry robberies, per PowerPyx and GTABase. Use the Snap Gun on the locked back door (kicking it sets the alarm off), find the safe code on a note in the back room, empty the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm — then leave; the trophy pops shortly after. PowerPyx recommends Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. They open with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, per PowerPyx and GTABase: tail a security van to its bank, slip in while the vault is open, and hand a bag to your partner — one character cannot carry it all. Each vault pays up to $205,000 and always brings a 4-star wanted level; escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000. The 100% checklist needs all 8, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. PowerPyx and GTABase both say robbing a bank vault counts — the same That's Where The Money Is… mission that unlocks vaults — as long as you then escape the red heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray. Earlier, you can also box in an armored truck near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back doors and blow them open, then get away. All 8 bank jobs are needed for 100% anyway.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the map. PowerPyx and GTABase both say the fastest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch until the whole map is visible. The trophy list as published by PSNProfiles counts 52 areas.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang is enough for the trophy, per PowerPyx and GTABase, but the 100% checklist needs all 39 operations. They show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically by story progress. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. PowerPyx pins it down: go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing next to the bar. GTABase lists the exact steps as still unconfirmed, so treat the bar and the drink as the reported method rather than a certainty. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. PowerPyx's reported method: after getting the Key Cloner in Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City, hack in, and drive straight through the window — the pop is slightly delayed and only that blue Banshee counts, a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. GTABase lists the exact steps as still unconfirmed. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all 3 key valuables from Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation first marked by the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, per PowerPyx and GTABase: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway (bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops after you escape the police, and you do not need all three in one visit — the robbery respawns after a long time, so PowerPyx says the trophy is not missable. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time, per PowerPyx and GTABase — check it under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). Only possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 opens character switching. Work out at fitness clubs with your partner along (Right + Triangle to call them): while one trains, the other completes their training too, doubling progress. GTABase adds you can also train at home after the story. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — the trophy list tracks the count to 500, per PowerPyx and GTABase. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) and watch for the demon-face icon whenever something counts. PowerPyx lists the profiles from Professional (stealthy, clean escapes) through Hardened, Violent and Psycho, and warns the Irredeemable profile is permanent — avoid pushing that far. It mostly happens passively across the other trophies. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The one trophy even the launch-week guides could not pin down: PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, and GTABase says only that 'second time's the charm' points to succeeding at something on a second attempt. No reliable method is published yet — this guide will not invent one. Check back after more players report it. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A UFO easter egg, per PowerPyx: at night after 2AM, go solo to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County and look for a blinking car at the roadside — it spawns only sometimes, so drive away and return if it is not there. Follow the path into the woods toward the bright blue light, approach the UFO, and it drops an abducted woman; talk to her, offer to help, and return to her car at the roadside. GTABase lists the exact steps as still unconfirmed. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be knocking enemies down with a kick while riding a motorcycle, and GTABase says only that the description points to a melee attack from a vehicle. No confirmed method is published yet — try the motorcycle kick once bikes are available, but treat it as unconfirmed. Not yet checked in the game by this guide's author — the steps above follow PowerPyx and GTABase as published 18–19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts — a running total, not one delivery. First finish Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, per PowerPyx and GTABase, then rob banks and Payday Loans and sell the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. Bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 each, so the robberies for 100% get you there.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, in total. PowerPyx and GTABase both say guns, car mods and tattoos burn through it fastest — the game counts 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 11 tattoo studios, 67 clothing stores and more. It lands naturally while kitting out for the other trophies.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — about $160,000 in total, per PowerPyx and GTABase; the 4 story garages do not count. They go on sale after Daily Driver in Chapter 2, when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy them through the app. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4, are the quick way to fund them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission with Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses), per PowerPyx and GTABase; take stolen vehicles to Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn, respray and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones too. You need free garage space first (see Little Boxes), each registration costs money, and cheap cars and bikes keep the bill down.
